sql_reading_A.note: 'advance sign-up' signaled by a non-null prerequisite
sql_reading_A.sql: SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 0 AND d.PREREQUISITES IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
